theorems.name: Submission.pit_rescaled_integral_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (F : Euclid n → Euclid P) (B : Set (Euclid n)) (J : Euclid n → ℝ) (K m : ℝ) (b : Euclid n) (f : Euclid P → ℝ), Continuous F → MeasurableSet B → Measurable J → (∀ a, 0 ≤ J a ∧ J a ≤ K) → 0 < m → (∀ a ∈ B, m * ‖a - b‖ ≤ ‖F a - F b‖) → DifferentiableAt ℝ F b → (∀ c, m * ‖c‖ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ F b c‖) → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => volume (B ∩ closedBall b ρ) / volume (closedBall b ρ)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 1) → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => ⨍ a in closedBall b ρ, ‖J a - J b‖ ∂volume) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => ∫ c, B.indicator J (b + r • c) * f (r⁻¹ • (F (b + r • c) - F b)) ∂volume) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (J b * ∫ c, f (fderiv ℝ F b c) ∂volume))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
